verses.gurmukhi: ਝੂਲਨਾ ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਧਰਮਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨੇਮਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jhoolanaa chha(n)dh: aadh dharamaadh bisamaadh gure nemeh pragaT pooran braham jot raakhee ||

en.bdb: Salutation to the True Guru the wondrous form of the (root of all) Lord, in whom God Himself has lodged His light effulgent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: mil chatur baran ik baran hui saadh sa(n)g sahaj dhun keeratan sabadh saakhee ||

en.bdb: In the congregation assembled before God-like True Guru, praises of the Lord are sung and recited. All four varnas (caste based sections of the society) then integrate into one caste society.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਜ ਧਾਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam nihakaam nij dhaam gursikh sravan dhun gursikh sumat alakh laakhee ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru whose base is Lord's name, listens to the melodious paeans of the Lord's praise. He then realises his self that helps him perceive the imperceptible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੈ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਲੈ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਾਖੀ ॥੧੪੪॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh kar kirapaa dhai jaa(n)h lai taa(n)h avagaeh pria preet chaakhee ||144||

en.bdb: The True Guru showers his benediction in very small measure on such a person who gets engrossed in it and relishes the loving elixir of Lord's love. (144)
